title: Fixed Size Array - Destructor
description:
Now that the class is technically complete, we should add one thing that makes it _safe_: This is a OOP feature called _**destructors**_. Constructors are called when a object is _created_, and destructors are called when a object _exits scope_. Destructors signature are similar to constructors. A destructor takes no arguments and it's name starts with `~`, EG `~AClass() {}`, and should clean up memory allocated by the class.
---
## Assignment:
Make the destructor for our array class! It should just delete our value field. (make sure to assign data to nullptr after)
